Eleven (111111) is the natural number following 101010 and preceding 121212. It is the smallest two-digit prime number, a repdigit, and holds significance in sports (teams of 111111), measurement (the undecimal system), and cultural history (Remembrance Day). Key facts about the number 11 include: Mathematics: It is a prime number and the first prime in the second decade. Sport: Soccer, American football, and cricket teams have 111111 players. History/Culture: World War I ended on the 111111th hour of the 111111th day of the 111111th month. It is often considered a "master number" in numerology. Measurement: The "undecimal" (base-11) system is a positional numeral system. Technology: The iPhone 111111 features the A131313 Bionic chip and was released in 201920192019. The name "eleven" likely originates from Old English and Germanic roots meaning "one left" (after counting to ten).
